CLOUD DESIGN-REVISION seat for the combined CI design (group R10-CI-LAYOUT) of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. Toolchain on PATH. Run heavy jobs in the background with Monitor.
Inputs: phase 1 at `probe/design-ci-layout` (b7a76185), phase 2 at `probe/design-ci-umbrella` (7fdd39c4), and the design review `probe/design-ci-review` (f7b28312, REVIEW.md + ev/), verdict `Design review: revise`. Read all three in full, plus CLAUDE.md, dev/governance/roles/judge.md, ci-autofix.md, gate-scoping.md and orchestrator.md from origin/main.
Task: revise both designs so that EVERY numbered item 1-12 in REVIEW.md is resolved soundly, never by narrowing a claim to dodge it. Address in particular: verdict events in their own concurrency group (item 1); gate kind recorded by an artifact, applicability from github.event_name, prelude must succeed (item 2); the retarget case (3); keep or replace the two rerun workflows and held-run approvals per the tree's measurements (4-6); carry recheck/no-skip (7); C1-drop numbers (8); null control that detects a dropped step (9); gate_replay must replay section 4.1's function (10); the unnamed readers (11); smaller corrections (12). Handle the D-1-refused branch too, though D-1 is approved. Owner rulings, already made: D-1 approve, D-2 arch-score gate-required when the diff reaches custom_components/, D-3 keep merge_group, D-4 drop C1 in PR 1 only if your revision shows the proof is covered, D-5 keep O17 with a soundness check; variant: a review event re-runs only budget-raise-gate and gate. Plan: two PRs, phase 1 first; the fixer phase fans out to cloud workers per unit, each with workflow_dispatch CI.
For each item add a section `## Review item N` saying what changed and the evidence (re-run the instruments you change). Return: commit the revised DESIGN-P1.md, DESIGN-P2.md, measure/ and a RESPONSE.md mapping items to changes, then push ONLY `refs/heads/probe/design-ci-rev1` (`git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/probe/design-ci-rev1` from a fresh orphan or branch commit). Do not open PRs, comment or edit any workflow on a real branch. No host paths in any text. Never work around a hook or refusal; report it.
